title: animated billboards
shortDescription: Four hundred animated sprites bouncing over a ground plane, drawn as billboards that face the camera
description: A `FeatureSprites` mesh of the `AnimatedSpriteKind` preset with room for 400 sprites, which runs with `placement: BillboardPlacement` and with depth test and depth write switched on, so the sprites turn towards the orbiting camera and hide each other in the right order. Unlike in *animated sprites*, the animation is built in code rather than read from the texture catalog: `FrameBasedAnimations.add()` takes a name, a duration of 0.66 seconds, the `TileSet` and the tile ids of the frames. `bakeDataTexture()` turns the animations into the `animsMap` of the mesh, and the `time` uniform drives them each frame. The ground is a plain three.js `PlaneGeometry` — the sprites share the scene with any other three.js object. A `ShadowPass` throws the shadow of every billboard onto the ground, each sprite turned to face the light first, so a shadow never thins out as the light circles: `bindUniform()` binds `groundPlane` to the ground mesh through `planeOf()` and `shadowLight` to a circling `DirectionalLight` through `lightOf()`.
